note: The single source of truth for what is built. docs/implementation-status.md is generated from this file by scripts/gen-status.mjs, which also refuses a claim of 'tested' that names no test or 'implemented' that names no source.

items.title: Pinned DSH baseline, consumed as published packages
items.acceptance_journey: npm run inventory:check

items.title: Every DSH client product capability classified, enforced by a gate
items.acceptance_journey: npm run verify:parity — 40/40 covered
known_limitations: Covers the client product tier. Host-tier packages are inventoried but not individually classified.

items.title: JSON-RPC over stdio with deadlines, cancellation, correlation, idempotency
items.acceptance_journey: Split frames, concurrent correlation, deadline, cancel-after-dispatch, engine loss
known_limitations: Remote HTTPS transport is defined in ADR-004 but not implemented; only stdio and mock exist.

items.title: Pydantic-sourced wire contracts with digest drift detection
items.acceptance_journey: The installed engine publishes the contract this build was written against
known_limitations: TypeScript types are maintained by hand against the emitted JSON Schema; the generator that would derive them is not built. The digest check is what catches drift.

items.title: Watch for DSH bundle installs into a stock profile
items.acceptance_journey: Install and uninstall against stock DSH 0.1.1-rc.2, upstream rows intact

items.title: Watch capabilities as DSH agent tools
items.acceptance_journey: 16 tools registered; refusals carry the engine's fix

items.title: Watch records in DSH's own event system, with replay determinism
items.acceptance_journey: Citation to evidence to trajectory, and back; replay hashes identically
known_limitations: Watch publishes its own view target rather than adding rows to DSH's trajectory ledger; upstream's contribution union is closed.

items.title: Unified Selection Model and deep links
items.acceptance_journey: Deep link, destroy client state, reopen, same logical selection
known_limitations: Restores a selection, not a scroll position; DSH's trajectory virtualization is its own.

items.title: Evidence Inspector showing resolved records
items.acceptance_journey: Shows evidence id, revision, range, provenance, artifacts, freshness, verification
known_limitations: Functionality first; the visual design belongs to Phase 3.
No browser test harness exists, so the React rendering is not covered by a gate. The rules it renders are tested in tests/presentation.test.mjs.

items.title: MemoryEvent ledger, correction precedence, real forgetting
items.acceptance_journey: Correct on next turn; forget survives restart and rebuild
known_limitations: The local ledger is not encrypted at rest. Desktop keychain integration is Phase 5.

items.title: Context Compiler with inclusion trace and token budget
items.acceptance_journey: Every included item carries a reason; a hard budget degrades to none
known_limitations: Relevance is lexical overlap. Semantic retrieval via an embeddings role binding is not wired.

items.title: Deterministic taste.md, index.md and log.md
items.acceptance_journey: Same ledger renders the same file; explicit and inferred stay separate
known_limitations: USER_EDIT import of a hand-edited Markdown file is defined in ADR-007 but not implemented.

items.title: Memory in the agent loop, bounded by ADR-008
items.acceptance_journey: Agent proposes; it cannot mint explicit_user or activate high-impact

items.title: Watch Core Bridge: handshake, capability truth, sensory and operator methods
items.acceptance_journey: 17 methods reachable; every method the tools call exists on the engine
known_limitations: Source lives in the watch-skill repository: src/watch_skill/surfaces/bridge/. Paths here point at this repo only.

items.title: Browser operator with durable receipts and approval gating
items.acceptance_journey: False-success fixture: page says success, API returns 500, verdict FAILED
known_limitations: The demo fixtures verify over HTTP. A Playwright-driven end-to-end browser fixture is not a release gate.

items.title: Watch brand and theme over DSH's token system
items.acceptance_journey: Watch Workspace reads as a Watch product; green reserved for VERIFIED
known_limitations: Occupies DSH brand slots and defines the token layer. The full workspace shell composition is a separate item.
No browser test harness, so the React slot occupancy is not covered by a gate; the tone rules are.

items.title: Agent / Watch / Live / Memory / Library / Compare / Trajectory modes
items.acceptance_journey: Each mode functions with real data

items.title: Composer extensions: sources, scope, observe, remember, act, verify, budget, privacy
items.acceptance_journey: Agent cannot silently widen source, egress or assurance scope

items.title: Memory surfaces: taste, timeline, wiki, decisions, lessons, failures
items.acceptance_journey: Confirm, edit, reject, dispute, forget, move scope, export

items.title: Role bindings over DSH Models and Providers
items.acceptance_journey: One connection serves several roles; no duplicate credential store
known_limitations: Contracts, lifecycle and admission rules are implemented and tested. The DSH Settings UI that edits bindings is not built.
Credential references point at DSH; no Watch credential store exists, by design.

items.title: Technology descriptors and capability lifecycle
items.acceptance_journey: Presence on disk does not equal ready
known_limitations: Descriptor, lifecycle and health contracts are implemented. The Settings surface that renders them is not built.

items.title: OCR engine family with isolated workers
items.acceptance_journey: Routed engine, canonical output, qualification state per workload
known_limitations: Descriptors, routing, canonical output shape and qualification contracts are implemented and tested.
The DeepSeek-OCR and OCR2 isolated Python workers are not implemented; only their descriptors, pinned revisions and admission rules exist.
No GPU is available on this machine, so neither DeepSeek engine is machine-tested. Both are correctly reported as requiring a GPU and are excluded by routing here.
Weight licences are unreviewed, so mayDistributeWeights() refuses both.

items.title: Language-aware evidence contract
items.acceptance_journey: Original text stays evidence authority; translation is derived
known_limitations: Script detection is range-based rather than full ICU: it reports which scripts appear, which is what direction and routing need. It is not language identification, and languageTags stay empty rather than guessed.
RTL-safe layout primitives exist as a contract (needsDirectionIsolation) but no UI consumes them yet.
No UI locale bundles are shipped. Claiming launch locales without reviewed translations would be worse than shipping none.

items.title: Live mode with gaps, clocks and reconnect
items.acceptance_journey: Start, observe, gap, reconnect, finalize, replay
known_limitations: Bridge methods and agent tools exist. No Live UI surface, and no long-session or reconnect gate.

items.title: Library of sources and evidence, separate from memory
items.acceptance_journey: Source revisions, hybrid search, facets, collections, stale state
known_limitations: Search and listing exist as Bridge methods and tools. No facets, collections or UI surface.

items.title: Compare runs, revisions and before/after states
items.acceptance_journey: First meaningful divergence, verified expected change, exported bundle

items.title: Workspace wiki projections with provenance
items.acceptance_journey: Generated pages cite sources and are never evidence authority

items.title: Optional Obsidian vault adapter
items.acceptance_journey: Export, open, backlinks, import diff; Watch works fully without it

items.title: LLMWiki-compatible import and export
items.acceptance_journey: Raw, wiki, citations, index and log round-trip without transferring authority

items.title: Candidate lifecycle with eval, promotion, canary and rollback
items.acceptance_journey: A candidate that fails eval is not promoted, and rollback restores

items.title: Electron shell around the same Workspace packages
items.acceptance_journey: Clean install, supervised Host and Core, deep link, safe shutdown

items.title: Third-party Watch capability developer path
items.acceptance_journey: A third-party capability installs without a fork and cannot mint VERIFIED

items.title: SBOM, licences, notices and model provenance gates
items.acceptance_journey: Repository licence never stands in for a model weight licence
known_limitations: Covers the Node tree. The Python side of watch-skill has its own dependency set that this SBOM does not enumerate.
Package integrity digests and a release manifest are not implemented.

items.title: Socket-level proof that offline_only means zero non-loopback egress
items.acceptance_journey: A UI toggle alone does not count
known_limitations: Implemented in watch-skill as tests/test_offline_egress.py: socket-level instrumentation asserting zero non-loopback egress for handshake, capability probes and verification, plus a guard proving the recorder itself works.
Paths here point at this repository only; the proof lives in the other repo.
Covers the Watch Core side. DSH provider routes and plugin update checks are not yet instrumented.

items.title: Tenant model, RBAC, remote workers and audit
items.acceptance_journey: Two tenants, zero cross-tenant leakage, audit, deletion
